'''Ganimed''' were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by the single [[Color/Legends|black]] horn on top of their [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] heads. The species had pointy [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and a ruddy brown and muddy yellow skin tone. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Purong]] was a member of the species.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' is set by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] events of {{Film|IV}} taking place, which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Purong visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and engaged in a [[lightfight]] against the [[Ariwook]] [[Rff Huff]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Ganimed appeared in [[1995]]'s ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'', written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. The species was designed by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
